parsed.reason: This is a perfect example of the plainest case. It asks one warm question ("How did Swim class go?"), names the activity without any invented specifics, explicitly takes off pressure ("No need to write back if not"), uses first person, contains no greeting, hype, exclamation marks, emoji, or padding, and doesn't assume the activity happened or went well. Short, plain, friendly—exactly like a friend who remembered and texted naturally.
